description: Folded into fz-acn.2. Elixir rejects `def take(n, <<s::binary-size(n), _::binary>>)` with "undefined variable n" (elixir_bitstring.erl:288-294: a size in a match reads the prematch or an earlier segment of the same binary); the defect is that fz reports it late with a backend string, not that the input is under-demanded. fz-acn.2 makes it an entry-planner diagnostic with a fixture.
title: A pinned bitstring size in a clause head is required by no scanner; interp refuses the call
